purpose: This dive will explore the Stetson Mesa South Scarp, part of the Blake Plateau. This area is part of the Stetson Miami Terrace Habitat Area of Particular Concern (HAPC) and was mapped on the first leg of the Windows to the Deep 2019 Expedition. The area has the potential to be a suitable habitat for deep sea corals and sponges. This area is a high priority region for the Southeast Deep-Sea Coral Initiative (SEDCI) from the NOAA Deep-Sea Coral Research and Technology Program.
